title: Online Evolution Strategy for Flow-Matching VLA Policies via Self-Supervised Trajectory Distribution Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models based on generative frameworks, such as Flow Matching, have recently achieved impressive performance in robotic manipulation. Unlike deterministic policies, Flow Matching enables VLA models to learn conditional action trajectory distributions, where latent noise vectors induce different actions under the same task scenario. However, we observe that these distributions are often ill-formed, with successful and failed behaviors coexisting while considerable probability mass remains in unfavorable regions. To this end, we propose Online-ES, an online adaptation framework for Flow Matching VLAs based on Evolution Strategy (ES), which refines the learned action trajectory distribution through interaction feedback. translated_title: 基于自监督轨迹分布优化的流匹配VLA策略在线进化策略
translated_abstract: 基于生成式框架（如流匹配Flow Matching）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近在机器人操作任务中取得了令人瞩目的性能。与确定性策略不同，流匹配使VLA模型能够学习条件动作轨迹分布，其中潜在噪声向量在同一任务场景下会诱导出不同的动作。然而，我们观察到这些分布往往是不良构型的，成功与失败的行为共存，同时相当大的概率质量仍停留在不利的区域。为此，我们提出了Online-ES，一个基于进化策略（Evolution Strategy, ES）的流匹配VLA在线自适应框架，它通过交互反馈来优化学习到的动作轨迹分布。我们的方法不是对潜在噪声空间进行剪枝，而是直接在动作轨迹空间中进行进化探索，其中流匹配生成的多样化轨迹提供了……
tldr: 提出Online-ES框架，利用进化策略直接在动作轨迹空间中进行在线进化探索，通过交互反馈优化流匹配VLA模型中不良构型的动作轨迹分布，从而提升机器人操作的成功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Online-ES, an online adaptation framework that applies Evolution Strategy to explore directly in the action trajectory space, using interaction feedback to refine the ill-formed action trajectory distributions learned by Flow Matching VLA policies for robotic manipulation.
